inventory.paper_item: Table III - mSA (%) of baseline trackers, per attribute [Protocol I]
inventory.reason: Protocol I is defined by the paper (SS III-E) as evaluation of trackers that used 'any training set except for those with UAV objects'. Both of our checkpoints are fine-tuned on the Anti-UAV IR train split, so entering them into Protocol I would violate the protocol's own precondition. Separately, the 40+ comparison trackers of Tables III/IV are third-party methods whose implementations and weights are not present in this repository, so the ranking itself cannot be reproduced. Our model's numbers under the identical metric are reported under Protocol II instead.
